rules: AI-generated or public-case-derived candidates may accelerate preparation but never count as approved_gold before qualified human review.
Frozen holdout cases must be designated before tuning against their outcomes.
Disputed cases are excluded from release metrics until adjudicated.
Reviewer identity may be pseudonymous in the public repo, but independence and qualification must be auditable in the controlled evidence pack.
Temporal scope is mandatory because legal correctness depends on the applicable legal state.
